newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Romanian Government started its weekly meeting. On the agenda was a bill on privatising state-run commercial banks.

* Recent changes on the board of state-run banks were conducted on the basis of competence and not political criteria, chairman of the National Peasant Party (PNTCD), Ion Diaconescu, told a news conferece.

* The leaders of PNTCD deny that the International Monetary Fund will postpone the first tranche of its programme of credits agreed with Romania's Government. They also said that an IMF mission is due in Bucharest this week to examine the progress of the government's reform programme. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
